You can now use Nostr WoT without importing your Nostr private key into the extension.

We have developed Nostr Connect support using NIP-46. Connect your own remote signer, then use compatible Nostr websites through the extension's NIP-07 browser interface.

Your identity key stays with your signer. Nostr WoT forwards signing requests, and your signer handles approvals according to the permissions you choose.

Pair by scanning the extension's QR code or pasting a bunker connection link. Amber offers Nostr Connect on Android; other compatible NIP-46 signers use the same protocol. Use a signer with compatible NIP-46 support; the setup guide includes current compatibility details.

If you prefer to keep your key on another device, you can still use the extension as your connection to the Nostr web.
